The words सर्व 'all' and the rest are called सर्वनाम or pronouns.

Terms: सर्वनाम
A सार्वधातुक -- तिङ्शित्सार्वधातुकम्

, affix not having an indicatory ङित्।

Terms: सार्वधातुक

Of the words having the same form and all in the same one case-termination, the last one is only retained.

Terms:
After a सर्वनामस्थान -- सर्वादीनि सर्वनामानि

, when it signifies the cause of an action and the word हेतु is used with it, the 3rd case-affix is used, as well as the 6th.

Terms: विभक्ति-3, 6

After the words सृ 'to go', शास् 'to order' and ऋ 'to go', अङ् is the substitute of च्लि in the परस्मैपद as well as the आत्मनेपद ।

Terms: च्लि
The affix यक् comes after a root when a सार्वधातुक -- तिङ्शित्सार्वधातुकम्

, follows, denoting the action or the object.

Terms: यक्

The affix खच् comes after the verb कष् 'to rub' when the words सर्व 'all', कूल 'bank', अभ्र 'cloud' and करीष 'a dry cow-dung' are in composition with it as objects.

Terms: खच्

The affix ष्फ is invariably added in the feminine after the words beginning with लोहित and ending with क्त when they take the affix यञ्।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

The feminine affix ङीन् comes after the words शार्ङ्गरव etc. and that which ends with the affix अञ्।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीन्

The affix फक् comes in denoting a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words 1. शरद्वत् 2. शुनक 3. दर्भा when they denote the descendants of भृगु , वत्स and अग्रायण , respectively. 

Terms: फक्

Optionally after the word शर्करा the 4-fold significant affix is elided by लुप् ।

Terms: चातुर्थिक-अञ्

The affix अण् comes always after the word हेमन्त and (before this affix) the letter त of हेमन्त is elided.

Terms: छन्दस्-अण्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'what stays there' after a word denoting a part of the body.

Terms: यत्

The affix तातिल् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the words 1. सर्व and 2. देव without altering the meaning.

Terms: तातिल्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'good for that' after a word denoting a part of the body.

Terms:

The affixes ण and ढञ् come in the sense of 'good for that' after the words सर्व and पुरुष।

Terms:

The affixes अण् (+/- -अ) and अञ् (+/- -अ) are respectively added to the words सार्वभूमि and पृथ्वी , in the above mentioned sense of 'a connection or a portent for its purpose'.

Terms:

The affix ख (ईन) and खञ् comes in the sense of 'wholly made thereof' after the word सर्वचर्मन्।

Terms: ख (ईन) and खञ्

The स is substituted for सर्व before a प्राग्दिशीय विभक्ति beginning with द।

Terms: प्राग्दिशीय - सर्व

After 1. सर्व 'all' 2. एक 'one' 3. अन्य 'other' 4. किम् 'what' 5 यद् 'which' and 6. तद् 'that' when time is denoted comes the affix दा , the words being in the Locative -7th case.

Terms: दा

The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'like this' after the words शर्करा etc.

Terms: अण्

After गो the subsequent अ may optionally be retained everywhere, in the Vedas as well as in the secular literature.

Terms: संहितायाम्

The acute is on the first syllable of सर्व when the case-endings follow.

Terms: accent-तिङ्

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word शारद having any other sense than that of 'autumnal'.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

The acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final of the word सर्व standing as the first member before an attributive word in the sense 'whole, through and through'.

Terms: समास end acute-1st-term

The final vowel of शर etc. is lengthened before मत् when it is a name.

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

In a अङ्ग (stem) ending in न् the preceding vowel is lengthened in strong cases with the exception of the Vocative Case singular.

Terms: Lengthening

After a Pronominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in अ , स्मै is substituted for the Dative -4th Case ending ए।

Terms: Some substitution
The गुण is substituted for the final इक् vowel of a अङ्ग (stem) before the affixes called सार्वधातुक and आर्धधातुक -- तिङ्शित्सार्वधातुकम्

etc.

Terms: गुण

After a Pronominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in long आ of the feminine, the Dative -4th Case, Ablative -5th case and Genitive 6th-Case singular get the augment स्याट् and the आ of the अङ्ग (stem) is shortened.

Terms: स्याट् augment

Of a reduplicate, the hard compound (aspirate and un-aspirate) when preceded by a sibilant, are only retained, the other consonants are elided.

Terms: Reduplicate
From here up to यथास्वे यथायथम्

, inclusive, is to be supplied always the phrase 'the whole word is repeated'.

Terms: Doubling of Words

The विसर्ग is the substitute when it is followed by a hard consonant (खर्) which itself is followed by a sibilant (शर्).

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि

There are not two in the room of a sibilant (शर्), when a vowel follows.

Terms:

According to the opnion of शाकल्य , there is reduplication no where.
